newsitem.title: ITALY: Generali to meet analysts on July 16.
newsitem.headline: Generali to meet analysts on July 16.

text.p: Italian insurer Generali has called a meeting with financial analysts on the morning of July 16 to discuss its results and business strategies, a source at a brokerage house said on Friday.

It is the first time the company has called such a meeting and follows remarks by Managing Director Gianfranco Gutty, quoted in the Wall Street Journal last week, that the company had been too aloof in its policy for too long. --Milan newsroom +392-66102321
